Name: Animated More New Fish
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[u][size=6][b]Animated More New Fish

[/b][/size][/u][size=3]Adds animations for all the fish and forage from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url]﻿ mods. You don't need the Mermaid Island mod to have More New Fish, but you do need More New Fish for the Mermaid Island.[/size]


[center][b][size=3]More New Fish[/size]
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/LRpGgQX.gif[/img][/u][/b]﻿
[size=3][b]Mermaid Island Fish[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rTQ2ESj.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6rqCoBW.gif[/img][/center][left][size=5][u][b]Installation[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url]﻿ 
﻿- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url]﻿ (Optional)[/size]
[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]

[u][b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/VUuloU3.gif[/img] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/7wLNgvy.gif[/img]

[size=5]Config[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i]config.json[/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.[/size]
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i]content.json[/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.[/size]

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "GhostEel1" and "GhostEel2". [u][b]You [/b][/u][/size][size=4][b][u]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/u]. [/b][/size][size=3]
[/size]

[b][u][size=5] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/bPZPHDN.gif[/img] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/4nMwdWp.gif[/img]
Extra
[/size][/u][/b][size=3]I couldn't figure out how to add/catch the Fugu fish, but I did make an animation for it (You can see it as the little GIF under the Mermaid Island Fish). 
Link to my other animated fish mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5735]Animated Fish[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6089]Animated Fish SVE[/url]﻿,  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7353]Animated Ridgeside Village Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10913]Animated East Scarp Fish[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11949]Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6974]Animated Lunna - Astay Fish[/url].
